additions.name: VITRO Cebu 2 Expansion

locator.uncertainty_reason: The map gives no surveyed tolerance for the host property.
locator.identity_review: EPI identifies VITRO Cebu 2 at A.S. Fortuna Street, Bakilid, Mandaue. Epsilon identifies its VITRO Cebu host inside the PLDT compound at this address. The OpenStreetMap branch name matches the road.

additions.distinctness_review: The named Cebu 2 expansion sits in the existing PLDT Mandaue compound. Cebu 1 and Cebu 2 are not counted as separate properties.
